summary: Trade Desk, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated loan and security agreement that upsizes its revolving credit facility to $750M with an accordion feature for an additional $750M. The facility matures April 14, 2031, is secured by substantially all assets, and bears variable interest at Base Rate or term SOFR plus a margin. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
